purpose: Provider-neutral qualification scenarios for payment adapters, external evidence, recovery and reconciliation.
profile_rule: Every concrete deployment must bind an adapter to an exact provider/product, jurisdiction, API or message version, instrument profile, capability profile, and finality profile. Generic family names are not executable provider profiles.
acceptance_invariants: A retry for one logical operation must not create a second value-moving effect.
Provider status is evidence, not a universal finality verdict.
Every amount is bound to exact instrument identity, currency, scale, and rounding policy.
Unknown outcomes remain indeterminate until read-after-timeout or reconciliation resolves them.
Returns, reversals, chargebacks, corrections and disputes append causal lineage; they do not erase prior evidence.
A multi-rail plan is not atomic unless every rail and coordinator capability proves the requested coordination semantics.
Missing provider, jurisdiction, message-version, authorization, or finality profiles fail closed before dispatch.
Credentials, secrets, full PANs and reusable authentication material never enter portable receipts or the fixture corpus.
Lossy mappings are declared; required authority-bearing fields must not be invented or silently defaulted.
Analytical output from Symthaea cannot grant payment authority or upgrade settlement state.

source_refs.relevance: Authoritative message-definition catalogue; exact message versions must be profile-bound.
Swift's May 2026 guidance for the November 2026 CBPR+ milestone; scope remains profile-specific, not a rule for every ISO 20022 usage.
Visa Direct Connect API products and supported payout status/return notifications; specific product profiles and onboarding determine actual capabilities.
Published reference schema includes a clientReferenceId on payout status notification; use the selected endpoint's current contract and never silently truncate/rewrite identifiers.
Existing settlement rail, finality and reconciliation specification.
Existing Finance fabric conformance profile proposal; this corpus complements rather than replaces it.
Existing professional banking and finance control-plane proposal.
Visa Direct documents client-reference conflict and amount/currency inconsistency errors for previously processed payout requests; exact handling remains bound to the applicable product profile.

cases.condition: A syntactically valid message uses a message definition version not admitted by the pinned adapter profile.
A positive payment status report is received, but the selected rail finality profile does not define that status as settlement-final.
cases.expected_financial_effect: retain the existing instruction lifecycle; do not book a final settlement solely from the status report

cases.condition: A payment return or reversal message refers to an earlier payment.
cases.expected_financial_effect: append a return/reversal candidate linked to the exact earlier effect; preserve the original event

cases.condition: A cross-border message under the selected Swift CBPR+ profile is evaluated at or after 2026-11-14 and uses an unstructured postal address prohibited by that profile.
The client times out after submission, and the provider may have accepted the payout.
cases.expected_financial_effect: no blind resubmission; resolve by provider reference or documented recovery/query contract before any retry

cases.condition: The same authenticated payout status notification is delivered multiple times.
cases.expected_financial_effect: one logical state transition; duplicate notification is retained or referenced without duplicating value movement

cases.condition: A payout return notification arrives after an earlier payout status was received.
cases.expected_financial_effect: record return as a later linked event; reconcile the returned amount and destination currency; preserve the original payout evidence

cases.condition: An external reference exceeds or violates the selected provider profile's documented identifier constraints, or shortening it would cause a collision.
A request reuses a Client Reference ID previously processed with a different request identity, amount, or currency.
cases.expected_financial_effect: none from the conflicting request; preserve the original operation identity and reconcile its provider state

cases.condition: A card authorization succeeds but no supported capture/clearing/settlement evidence exists.
cases.expected_financial_effect: represent the authorization or hold only; do not classify proceeds as settled funds

cases.condition: A capture request times out and its outcome is unknown.
cases.expected_financial_effect: no retry as a new capture until the original operation is resolved under the processor's idempotency contract

cases.condition: A dispute or chargeback arrives after a previously recorded capture or settlement.
cases.expected_financial_effect: record a dispute/chargeback event with linked evidence; do not erase the initial transaction or presume the dispute outcome

cases.condition: A proposed cross-border route names a region or policy initiative but no exact participating rail, provider, participant eligibility, currency pair, and jurisdiction profile.
A local payment succeeds at one participating system but the cross-border receiving leg has not been evidenced.
cases.expected_financial_effect: preserve the completed origin-leg evidence and represent the other leg as unknown; recover only under a qualified coordination/saga plan

cases.condition: An FX quote is expired, has the wrong currency pair, or cannot explain the exact rounded settlement amount.
cases.expected_financial_effect: none until a current quote, rate convention, fee treatment, and rounding rule are qualified

cases.condition: A webhook or callback fails its configured authenticity check or is a replay outside the accepted replay window.
Reconciliation discovers an amount, currency, instrument, beneficiary, fee, or source-identity mismatch.
cases.expected_financial_effect: preserve all source events and open a typed exception; do not silently normalize or close the payment

cases.condition: A multi-leg plan contains an irreversible submission on one rail and an unknown result on another, while atomic commitment is unsupported.
cases.expected_financial_effect: retain per-leg outcomes; no synchronized-completion claim; recover or compensate only under a previously qualified plan

cases.condition: A requested PandaCard integration has not been bound to a verified product identity, legal provider, technical documentation, jurisdiction, and settlement counterparties.
